places.name: Hawkeye's Farmhouse
places.connection: A farmhouse and property in this rural area served as the location for Clint Barton's family home, seen in the tragic opening scene.

places.name: Thor's visit to 2013 Asgard
places.connection: Interior shots of Asgard, particularly scenes involving Thor and his mother Frigga, were filmed here for 'Thor: The Dark World' and revisited for 'Endgame'.

places.name: Trilith Studios (formerly Pinewood Atlanta Studios)
places.connection: Primary production facility where most interior scenes and the massive final battle sequence were filmed on soundstages and backlots.

places.name: Stark's Cabin
places.connection: The real-world location of the lakeside cabin where Tony Stark lives with his family. A key setting for the film's first act.

places.name: New Asgard
places.connection: This picturesque fishing village served as the location for New Asgard, the Earthly home of the surviving Asgardians.

places.name: Avengers Headquarters (Exterior)
places.connection: The exterior of this building was used for the Avengers Compound. It was digitally altered and expanded with CGI.

places.name: Tokyo Street Scene (Hawkeye)
places.connection: Streets in downtown Atlanta, including near 'The Gulch', were dressed with Japanese signage and neon lights to portray Tokyo, where Hawkeye operates as Ronin.

places.name: 1970s Camp Lehigh
places.connection: The exteriors of this corporate campus were used to film the scenes where Tony Stark and Steve Rogers infiltrate Camp Lehigh in 1970.

places.name: 1970s New Jersey Street
places.connection: Locations in this Hudson Valley town were used to film the 1970s New Jersey setting for the Camp Lehigh sequence.

places.name: Gristmill Time Machine Test Site
places.connection: The historic gristmill at Starr's Mill was the location where the team first tests the quantum time machine.
